outputs: Generated textual responses to visual/audio inputs (question answers, captions)
textual answers or captions generated by the MLLM
The generated outputs include answers to visual and audio questions and captions for images and audio.

changes_made.explanation: No changes made - all extracted metadata accurately reflects the NLG tasks addressed in the paper
Cross-entropy loss is used as a training objective, not as an evaluation metric for generated outputs. The paper does not use any automatic NLG evaluation metrics like BLEU, ROUGE, etc.
The paper mentions LLMs are used only for refining natural language writing, not as judges/evaluators of generated outputs
No human evaluation is conducted in this paper

overall_notes: This paper focuses on multimodal instruction tuning methodology rather than NLG evaluation. While it addresses NLG tasks (visual/audio QA and captioning), it uses cross-entropy loss for training optimization rather than standard NLG evaluation metrics. The main contribution is a coordinated learning approach for balancing multimodal learning, not evaluation methodology.
